### Window inspected
2026-05-15 latest durable autoheal incidents plus 24h autoheal action history, trends, transitions, and uptime.

### Signal counts
34 open incidents: 24 host_integrity, 9 unclean_boot, 1 autoheal_failure. Latest 50 autoheal actions: 10 successes, 40 failures.

### Signal picked
Autoheal scenario restart heal-loop / slow-restart pattern.

### Pattern observed
32 of 40 failed restart actions timed out at 90s; 7 failed with `exit status 1`, including lifecycle lock messages like “Scenario restart blocked by concurrent invocation.” Transitions show the same scenarios later returning healthy, led by web-console with 8 transitions in 24h.

### Hypothesized root cause
Restart policy likely treats slow or already-in-flight lifecycle work as fresh failures instead of reconciling status and applying lock-aware backoff.

### Proposed action
Decision `dec-1778888027214366413`: make autoheal scenario restart actions lock-aware and reconcile health after restart timeouts before retrying.

### Measurement plan
Track restart result, duration, lock-holder pid, post-timeout scenario status, and next transition time per scenario.

### Missing CLI or telemetry surfaces
Need first-class aggregate action-loop summary by scenario/error/post-timeout recovery; current workflow required manual `jq` correlation across history and transitions.

### Dimension grades
Architecture B; security B; test coverage B; documentation C+; cross-platform C; signal B-; instrumentation B-.

### Top finding
`scenarios/prompt-manager/cli/install.ps1` omits `-Manifest scenarios/prompt-manager/.vrooli/service.json`, unlike Unix and peer scenario PowerShell installers. Windows installs can miss the sibling manifest and use a freshness contract that disagrees with runtime stale checking.

### Measurement plan
Add a static/contract test that scenario `install.ps1` wrappers pass `-Manifest` when `service.json` declares `cli.freshness`, and bring `packages/cli-core/install.ps1` freshness/context behavior to Unix parity.

### Window inspected
2026-05-16 durable autoheal incidents, latest 50 autoheal actions, 24h transitions/trends, autoheal status, and attempted system-monitor surfaces.

### Signal counts
34 open incidents: 24 host_integrity, 9 unclean_boot, 1 autoheal_failure. Autoheal status: 59 checks, 46 ok, 10 warning, 3 critical. Latest 50 actions: 8 successes, 42 failures; failures were 32 timeouts, 9 exit status 1, 1 API start script not found.

### Signal picked
Repeat failure: web-console restart remediation blocked by invalid scenario manifest.

### Pattern observed
The two newest web-console restart actions, IDs 11003 and 11004, failed in 4ms with `discover scenario CLI "web-console": parse /home/matthalloran8/Vrooli/scenarios/web-console/.vrooli/service.json: invalid character ']' looking for beginning of value`. Transitions show web-console went ok->critical at 2026-05-16T22:00:36Z and critical->ok at 22:22:36Z; trends still show currentStatus ok with 716/729 ok checks.

### Hypothesized root cause
The web-console service manifest is malformed, and autoheal treats deterministic scenario CLI discovery/manifest parse errors as generic restart failures rather than permanent scenario configuration defects.

### Proposed action
Decision `dec-1778974408126433951`: classify scenario CLI discovery and manifest parse failures as permanent config failures, suppress retry loops for that scenario/error tuple, and route a scenario-quality bug/incident payload with scenario id, manifest path, parse error, action id, and last transition.

### Measurement plan
Track restart error class, manifest path, parse error, retry suppression decision, associated scenario status transition, and time-to-recovery by non-autoheal path.

### Missing CLI or telemetry surfaces
`system-monitor` CLI could not resolve API base in this context. `vrooli scenario status ... --json` failed with runtime registry database open error. `report-bug` skill says universal cross-team bug writes are valid, but `prompt-manager team knowledge-add scenario-qa` was rejected with `team_mismatch`; bug evidence is preserved in infra-health audit instead.

### Slice audited
`lifecycle-internals`: `internal/lifecycle` Runner start/stop/restart flow, scenario locks, runtime registry sessions, health checks, Postgres bootstrap helpers, process-control shims, and focused tests.

### Dimension grades
Architecture B; security B-; test coverage B; documentation B-; cross-platform C+; signal B; instrumentation B-.

### Top finding
`cleanupScenarioRuntimeWithRegistry` returns immediately when `verifyPortsReleased` reports a still-bound port, before `RemoveScenarioLocks` and `runtimeStop.finish`. This contradicts the helper’s own comment that partial stop should continue cleanup, and can leave stale port locks plus active runtime claims/leases after Stop/Restart failures.

### Measurement plan
Add a stop-path contract test with a persistent listener/fake runtime store proving Stop returns the still-bound diagnostic while still removing scenario locks and releasing/stopping runtime registry state. Then refactor cleanup to collect verification errors, run best-effort bookkeeping cleanup, and return an aggregated error.
